title: A rules story's check confirms the step a new rule names exists in the tools, not only that its tested question packs good
goal: Planning gives a story that adds a _self rule naming a tool step (a finding kind, a command, a note a tool reads) a check that runs or finds that step in the tools; in SP-enudabdr ST-aezkm3zh's rule says a wrong-root gap is recorded as a rules finding, which ql_learn.rules_miss makes only from a _self lookup, and its check read only pack coverage (BG-sddebrpa)
